Maya (Presales): Quick request — customer demo tomorrow AM. Need a one-page POC cheat: streaming SDK examples (Node + Go), a tiny function/tool-call pattern that enforces structured JSON output, handshake cURL for ephemeral token flow, and a short security Q&A (KMS, retention, SOC2 link). Can someone assemble a compact draft by EOD?

Omar (Eng): I can draft. Confirm hosted EU and ephemeral tokens required? Also want a fallback to a quantized model for cost spikes?

Tess (Sales): Yes EU. Ephemeral tokens preferred. Fallback to quantized small OK. Finance will fill pricing placeholders. Logs must be off by default.

Omar (Eng): Draft (compact):
- Objective: demo streaming chat + function call with schema check.
- Env: Hosted (eu), primary: r-infer-2, fallback: r-infer-2-quant-small.
- Auth: short-lived token (exchange server -> /v1/token). KMS for long-term secrets; TLS required. Logs off by default; retention configurable. SOC2 link to be added by legal.

Node snippet (minimal):
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN, region: 'eu' });
const s = client.chat.stream({ model: 'r-infer-2' });
s.on('event', e => { if (e.type === 'function_call' && e.schemaHash === 'sha256:abc') fetch('https://hooks.customer/do',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(e.payload)}); });

Go snippet (minimal):
cli := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_TOKEN"))
stream := cli.ChatStream(ctx, redwood.ChatParams{Model:"r-infer-2",Region:"eu"})
for ev := range stream.Events() { if ev.Type==redwood.EventFunctionCall && ev.SchemaHash=="sha256:abc" { http.Post("https://hooks.customer/do","application/json", bytes.NewReader(ev.Payload)) } }

Handshake cURL (SSE):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat?model=r-infer-2&region=eu"

Operational knobs: batching window 10-20ms, KV prefix cache enabled. Fallback: route to r-infer-2-quant-small when queue latency >80ms or GPU util >75%.

Security bullets: EU-only endpoints for this POC; TLS in transit; KMS-managed keys at rest (HSM optional); inference logs non-persistent by default; SOC2/DPA links pending. Incident contact: secops@redwood.ai.

Troubleshooting quick hits: 401 -> check token exchange & clock skew; SSE stalls -> missing Accept header or CORS; webhook failures -> TLS cert or IP allowlist.
